WITH item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE (i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') AND
           i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') AND
           i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg   #14','scholaramalgamalg   #7', 'exportiunivamalg    #9','scholaramalgamalg    #9')) OR
          ((i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') AND
            i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') AND
            i_brand IN ('amalgimporto   #1','edu packscholar   #1','exportiimporto   #1', 'importoamalg    #1')))
), store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_manager_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) sum_sales
    FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_manager_id
), avg_sales AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, AVG(sum_sales) avg_monthly_sales
    FROM store_sales_filtered
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
)
SELECT tmp1.i_manager_id, tmp1.avg_monthly_sales, tmp1.sum_sales
FROM (
    SELECT item_filtered.i_manager_id, avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales, store_sales_filtered.sum_sales
    FROM item_filtered JOIN store_sales_filtered ON item_filtered.i_item_sk = store_sales_filtered.ss_item_sk AND item_filtered.i_manager_id = store_sales_filtered.ss_manager_id
    JOIN avg_sales ON item_filtered.i_manager_id = avg_sales.i_manager_id
) tmp1
WHERE CASE WHEN tmp1.avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN ABS(tmp1.sum_sales - tmp1.avg_monthly_sales) / tmp1.avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY tmp1.i_manager_id, tmp1.avg_monthly_sales, tmp1.sum_sales 
LIMIT 100
